children: Wintermute had about $101 million in open positions and lost approximately $933,500 over the past 24 hours. According to Odaily, its positions on Hyperliquid included short positions in SOL, DOGE, LINK, LDO and VIRTUAL valued at about $87.66 million; the portfolio had roughly $882,900 in unrealized gains, while cumulative profits from perpetual contracts totaled about $209.15 million.

title: Wintermute Holds $101 Million in Open Positions, Loses $933,500 in 24 Hours
